claim: Mixed Integer Programming (MIP) methods can solve the most difficult instances of the protein threading problem in a reasonable amount of time.
falsifier: One can implement MIP formulations for protein threading and test on difficult instances to observe solution times.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported performance of MIP methods on difficult protein threading instances; transfer to other problem domains is unestablished.

title: Mixed Integer Programming methods for solving difficult instances
